def median_two_sorted(a, b):
    # Combine the two sorted lists
    merged = a + b
    # Sort the merged list
    merged.sort()
    # Calculate the median
    n = len(merged)
    mid = n // 2
    if n % 2 == 0:
        return (merged[mid - 1] + merged[mid]) / 2
    else:
        return merged[mid]
